text.lead: Wild Target (French: Cible émouvante) is a 1993 French comedy film written and directed by Pierre Salvadori. Its plot revolves around an aging hitman who falls for his much younger target and ends up protecting her. A remake directed by Jonathan Lynn was released in 2010.
